# Leaflet vendor files

This directory vendors selected files from `leaflet@1.9.4` for stable GitHub Pages delivery.

Included files:

- `leaflet.css`
- `leaflet.js`
- `images/layers.png`
- `images/layers-2x.png`
- `images/marker-icon.png`
- `images/marker-icon-2x.png`
- `images/marker-shadow.png`

Upstream project:

- <https://leafletjs.com/>
- <https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet>

License:

- Leaflet is distributed under the BSD 2-Clause License.
- Source package used for these files: `leaflet@1.9.4` from npm.
